visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) At a night concert, a young woman with long dark hair wearing a white top looks excitedly at the camera with her mouth open. The shot cuts to a stage where a female singer (Nayeon) performs with back-up dancers under bright spotlights and large video screens. (2) Daytime outdoors, the woman is seen in a medium close-up, wearing sunglasses on her head and gesturing towards her cheek to show her makeup. The background is a bustling street or event plaza with white tents and many people passing by in the distance. (3) Inside a brightly lit indoor space with white walls, the woman wears a light blue shirt and a black cat-ear headband with a pink character on it. She applies skincare essence to her face using her hands. Close-up shots show the clear liquid being poured from a glass bottle and her finger touching her smooth skin. (4) Back at the night concert venue, the woman holds a silver beverage can and smiles at the camera, pointing to her face to demonstrate her makeup's durability. The background shows a crowd of people and colorful carnival-style lighting. (5) A close-up shot of a smartphone screen displays the time 11:36 on July 4th. The woman then returns to the indoor setting, applying more skincare product to her face while looking into the camera. (6) She is now at a red-branded SK-II promotional stand inside a shopping mall. She holds a bottle of the product and a cup of Häagen-Dazs ice cream, waving happily to the viewers. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom throughout the video.
